checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The side profile of the fish clearly shows an elongated snout and the mouth is located on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although slightly blurry due to distance/resolution, four distinct dangling structures are visible near the snout tip, matching the barbel count.
The snout tapers to a distinct point, characteristic of many sturgeon species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct ridges and bumps are visible along the lateral line and dorsal ridge, representing the characteristic scutes rather than smooth scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, while the belly area facing the camera is significantly lighter/whitish.
The tail fin is clearly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe extending further than the lower lobe, a defining trait of sturgeons.
